title: Real invitation mail goes out as Sarah <ceo@tracy.ai>, and /ops shows the same sender
steps: Run the send ledger suite against a private PostgreSQL (TEST_DATABASE_URL) with fake Google, and the mounted harness flow suite, from this branch.
expect: A test send to an allowed address makes one messages.send whose raw message has the header From: Sarah <ceo@tracy.ai>.
Send a test in Review content names the mailbox sender as Sarah <ceo@tracy.ai>.
evidence: Test emails sent from dev on 14 and 15/10/2026 showed the sender as the previous signer while the letters are now signed Sarah.
fence: Fake Google only; no credential, no real mailbox, no customer address.

tests: a test send goes to an allowed address once, is ledgered before the call, and a repeat changes nothing
Send a test lists only the server test addresses and sends the approved email once per press
